_comment: Zones de développement majeures (polygones APPROXIMATIFS, dessinés à la main — ordre lng,lat). status: acted = financé/en chantier ; pending = décidé sur le papier, pas irréversible ; delivered = livré. horizon = échéance annoncée. Pour ajuster une zone : éditer ici puis `npm run geo:corridors`.

zones.name: Bang Sue — Krung Thep Aphiwat (SRT land, ph.2 2026-2029)
zones.note: Central terminal + 18 SRT plots under development. Watch: current condo oversupply in the area.

zones.name: Makkasan — HSR 3 airports TOD (pending, ≥2032)
zones.note: 140-rai depot slated for HSR terminal + mixed-use. Contract amendment stalled (caretaker gov.) — a long option, not a commitment.

zones.name: Khlong Toei Port redevelopment (pending, →2035)
zones.note: 2,353 rai, ~100bn THB mixed-use waterfront; zoning upgrade to Por 5 rides on the 2027 city plan.

zones.name: Rama IV corridor — One Bangkok / Dusit Central Park (delivered)
zones.note: Luxury cluster delivered/near-complete: mostly priced in. Rent-side play rather than capital-gain play.
